CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD(DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) + 0 + 2, /* Sun:Date+0 wknd day+1 day */ 4, DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) + 1 + 2 + 1, /* Fri:Date+2 wknd days+1 day */ 5, DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) + 2 + 2, /* Fri:Date+2 wknd days+1 day */ 6, DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) + 1 + 2, /* Sat:Date+1 wknd days+1 day */ DATEVALUE(LLV_Start_Date__c) + 2 /* Default (Mon/Tue/Wed):Date+1day */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (2nd)
